claims: Continue continuous cardiac and vital sign monitoring with alarms for tachycardia, hypertension, and tachypnea.
Repeat basic metabolic panel and magnesium within 24 hours to reassess electrolytes and anion gap.
Reassess pain and administer multimodal analgesia as needed, including acetaminophen.
Continue supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula at 2 L/min with continuous pulse oximetry.
Perform delirium and sedation assessment with CAM-ICU and Richmond-RAS each shift.
Mobilize patient out of bed with assistance as tolerated, given bedfast status.
Maintain fall precautions and bed rest safety measures given Braden activity score and bedfast status.
Obtain 12-lead ECG if tachycardia persists, given heart rate up to 134 bpm.
Continue home medications including atorvastatin and amlodipine per active orders.
Maintain IV access with saline lock and continue isotonic fluids as ordered.
